verified_ok.item: All 25 executable YAMLs: parameterMapping count/order match Actions.psc signatures (positional).
All 29 action names unique; no speaking_victim; static uses value / dynamic uses description.
Fixed-role assault uses TargetVictim/SpeakerVictim; none_rape uses Nonconsensual_Two + victim.
setting_name values that are non-empty resolve to existing scene JSON (incl. punish_pleasure_pain_rape).
Helper/stop/outfit prompts read _activity / _options; activity/narration prompts read _threads/_actors/_speaking_modifiers underscore keys.

questions_for_author.question: For penetration direction: should YAML adopt Papyrus token "fuck a", or should Actions.psc accept "fucked in|fucking|fucking a" (and giving|getting for oral/vaginal/anal)?
For punish spanking/whipping: prefer split TargetVictim/SpeakerVictim actions (like rape), or keep dynamic victim and drive speaker_position from victim?

finding.problem: Direction vocab advertised to the LLM does not match what StartScene_Event recognizes for oral/vaginal/anal. Actions.psc only sets speaker_position=1 when direction == "fuck a". YAML offers "fucked in|fucking" (fucking actions) or "fucking a|fucked in" (none_rape). None of those strings match, so "receiving" never swaps actor slots — speaker always stays SexLab position 0.
finding.evidence: Actions.psc ~219-222: if method oral/vaginal/anal and direction == "fuck a" then speaker_position = 1. sexlab_sex_sex_fucking.yaml L26: description: fucked in|fucking sexlab_none_rape.yaml L28: giving|getting|fucking a|fucked in
finding.fix: Author Q1: either change YAML direction options to include the exact token "fuck a" (and document it), or widen Actions.psc to accept fucked in / fucking / fucking a (and ideally giving|getting for penetration). Keep Two vs Three parameter order unchanged.
finding.assumptions: speaker_position still drives Action_Start actor array order (Manager ~630-636).

finding.problem: Fixed-role assault YAMLs expose direction as giving|getting while method includes oral|vaginal|anal. For those penetration methods, giving/getting are ignored by StartScene_Event (only "fuck a" flips position). Victim faction is set correctly via TargetVictim/SpeakerVictim, but SexLab position order (and thus scene speaking_modifiers / male_position assumptions) will not invert for "getting" penetration.
finding.evidence: sexlab_sex_rape_target.yaml L23-26: method oral|vaginal|anal|...; direction giving|getting Actions.psc L219-228: penetration branch only checks "fuck a"; giving/getting only hit the final elseif for non-penetration methods.
finding.fix: Same as H1/Q1: align direction options with Papyrus for penetration methods, or extend Papyrus. Optionally split assault into fucking-style vs giving-style actions (mirror consensual fucking/giving).
finding.assumptions: Victim wrappers only SetVictim; they do not force victim into actors[0].

finding.problem: Dynamic victim + static empty direction. StartScene_Event leaves speaker_position=0 whenever direction is "". Scene JSON assigns victim-side speaking_modifiers to position 0 (_pain_ / _pain_,_gagged_). When LLM picks victim=target, the speaker (assailant) still occupies position 0 and receives victim speaking modifiers; the actual victim gets the empty/pleasure slot.
finding.evidence: sexlab_punish_spanking.yaml L18-29: dynamic victim; direction value: "" punish_spanking.json: speaking_modifiers ["_pain_",""] punish_whipping_oral.json: speaking_modifiers ["_pain_,_gagged_","_pleasure_"] Actions.psc L223-225: spanking/whip only flip when direction is giving|give Manager Action_Start L630-636: speaker_position selects actors[0]/actors[1]
finding.fix: Author Q2: preferred YAML fix per locked YAML-Victim — split into TargetVictim / SpeakerVictim actions (like punish rape), with direction set so victim lands in position 0; OR keep dynamic victim and derive speaker_position from whether victim==speaker. Also remove misleading [direction] from descriptions when direction is unused (see M2).
finding.assumptions: Scene speaking_modifiers arrays are index-aligned with SexLab positions after Action_Start.

finding.problem: method may be "kissing", but setting_name is always nonsexual_male_position_1 (empty speaking_modifiers). Menu path loads nonsexual_kissing (tags=kissing, speaking_modifiers=_kissing_). LLM kissing actions therefore miss _kissing_ prompt rules in 0050_sexlab_activity.prompt.
finding.evidence: comfort_general / nonsexual_general setting_name "nonsexual_male_position_1" Menu.psc ~209: setting_name = "nonsexual_kissing" when kissing selected nonsexual_kissing.json: speaking_modifiers "_kissing_"; tags "kissing" 0050_sexlab_activity.prompt L93: contains(..., "_kissing_")
finding.fix: Dedicated kissing action with setting_name nonsexual_kissing, or map method kissing → that setting in Papyrus (out of YAML-only scope). At minimum document that YAML kissing will not get _kissing_ mods.

finding.problem: Description placeholders include [direction] but direction is static "". LLM sees an empty direction slot in the action template, which confuses generation and overlaps with H3.
finding.evidence: spanking L3: "[Victim] is punished by [direction] [style] spanking"; L28-29 direction value: "" whipping L3: "[Victim] is punished by [direction] oral sex..."; L28-29 direction value: ""
finding.fix: Drop [direction] from description while direction stays empty; or make direction dynamic (and fix H3).

finding.problem: Creator.AddTag(method) uses method as a SexLab tag. comfort_cuddle allows sitting|laying (unlikely SexLab tags). comfort_general allows "cuddle" while SexLab/Menu typically use "cuddling". Weak or empty animation matches likely.
finding.evidence: Scene_Creator.Setup calls AddTag(_method) after SetMethod RemapTag only remaps mouth/pussy/ass — not cuddle/sitting/laying Menu.psc uses method-ish "cuddle" with setting nonsexual_male_position_1
finding.fix: Align method options with real SexLab tags (e.g. cuddling) or put tags in scene JSON and leave method descriptive only. Clarify intended tags for sitting|laying with author before changing.
finding.assumptions: SexLab animation library does not widely tag "sitting"/"laying" alone.

finding.problem: Bare {{ speaker }} emits the whole speaker object into final instructions on every render. Likely leftover debug; pollutes LLM context with raw actor JSON (_uuid, _formid, modifiers, …).
finding.evidence: L19-48 builds speaker; L62 {{ speaker }}; L63+ uses speaker fields for rules.
finding.fix: Remove line 62 unless SkyrimNet requires dumping that object for tooling. Prefer structured prose only.
finding.assumptions: Inja {{ object }} stringifies to JSON/map text visible to the model.

finding.problem: Helper prompts use stale [type] placeholders and are not referenced by any action YAML (no render_template). Prompts.md claims they are tied to actions; assault YAMLs use inline descriptions with [method] instead. Dead/misleading helpers risk future wiring bugs.
finding.evidence: Grep: only sexlab_none_change_outfit / sexlab_none_stop use render_template("helpers/...") rape helpers: "[style] [type] sexually assault..." Current sexlab_sex_rape_target.yaml description uses [method], not helpers
finding.fix: Wire helpers via render_template and update [type]→[method], or delete/move to docs, or mark unused in Prompts.md.

finding.problem: Static intent value "refused" is interpolated by StartScene_Refused_Two into "... refused to allow {intent} by ...", producing "refused to allow refused by ...".
finding.evidence: Actions.psc L163: msg = target_name+" "+style+" refused to allow "+intent+" by " YAML intent value: refused
finding.fix: Set intent to a noun phrase matching the category (sexual activities / comforting / showing affection), matching punish_refused which uses value: punish.

finding.problem: Category PARAMS still use key "type" while executable children and Actions.md prefer Papyrus slot name "method". LLM category hints can disagree with child action parameter names.
finding.fix: Rename PARAMS keys type→method (and [type]→[method]) in category parent descriptions.
Pick one adverb form across all sexlab_* actions (prefer forcefully|normally|gently to match GetStyleDialog).

finding.problem: Actions.md documents customCategory sexlab_none, but there is no sexlab_none_.yaml category parent and none_* executables omit customCategory. They still load as top-level actions; category gating/docs drift.
finding.fix: Add sexlab_none_.yaml + customCategory: sexlab_none on those four files, or update Actions.md to say they are uncategorized.

finding.problem: Scene JSONs exist that no action YAML references via setting_name (Menu/Creator still may load them). Couples with M1 for nonsexual_kissing.
finding.fix: No change required if Menu-only; otherwise wire kissing YAML (M1). Informational.
